_meta.provenance: Decoded from cnc_eu.z64, read-only RE pass. See particle_recipes_notes.md for the full derivation and code addresses.
_meta.anim_table: 66 entries x 12B {char* name, SourceSlot* slots, u32 nslots} at CodeOverlay ROM 0x1B6444 / RAM 0x80214654 (n64specialeffect.c)
_meta.slot_layout: 16B: {u8 source_id, u8 fire_stage, u16 pad, s32 dx, s32 dy, s32 dz}; source_id 0 = empty slot
_meta.source_table: 65 records x 0x44B at CodeOverlay ROM 0x1B41C0 / RAM 0x802123D0; names are the ROM's own SOURCE_* strings

spawn_semantics.when: the effect driver runs per anim stage: a slot fires when stage >= fire_stage (continuous sources, burst_ticks==0, re-fire every stage) or exactly at stage == fire_stage (burst sources, burst_ticks>0)
spawn_semantics.emitter: an emitter node is placed at anim world pos + offset; dy is relative to terrain height at (x,z), dx/dz are world units (cell = 256)
spawn_semantics.burst: a burst action lives burst_ticks ticks; each tick it emits trunc(count) particles then count *= per_tick_multiplier, starting from particles_per_tick
per_particle: velocity = speed * ( sin(angle_b), cos(angle_b)*cos(angle_a), sin(angle_a) )  [x, y-up, z]
size  = size_base + rand8/256 * size_rand   [world units; for VehicleDamage/StructureDamage debris it scales the 3D chunk]
each tick: pos += velocity; velocity.y += visual.y_accel_per_tick
spawn_semantics.debris: sources on VehicleDamage/StructureDamage (SOURCE_Debris/Debris2) additionally build a ParticleExplosion object: chunk gravity -2/tick, elasticity 0.7, constants {2, 1, -2, 20, 5} at CodeOverlay ROM 0x16B3E0-0x16B3F0; each chunk carries a child emitter (smoke trail)

_meta.units: positions/sizes in world units (1 cell = 256 -- CORRECTED; this field said 192, which is wrong and makes every particle offset, speed and size 33% too large. The cell pitch is 256 everywhere in the cartridge: the terrain vertex builder writes vtx.x = x*256 and vtx.z = y*256 (tools/romdump/heightmap_notes.md:12/:69) and the camera distance is in leptons at 256 per cell (docs/n64-camera-math.md:14/:18)); angles in radians; ticks = anim/effect ticks (the same tick the anim stage advances on)
